name: Deal Desk, RFP & Pipeline Hygiene Engine
description: Accelerates RFP security/compliance questionnaires with TF-IDF answer matching, validates multi-year SaaS quote discounts and gross margins against Deal Desk approval tiers, and audits CRM pipeline for slippage and multi-currency traps.

skills.summary: Matches RFP requirement rows against verified answer libraries using TF-IDF cosine similarity and flags mandatory compliance gaps.
Computes net effective discount, multi-year ramp ACV/TCV, gross margin floor compliance, non-standard terms, and required Deal Desk tier.
Audits CRM opportunities for stage staleness, push counts, missing MEDDPICC commit gates, single-threading, and multi-currency FX alignment.
